shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && echo "---PACKAGE---" && cat /workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null && echo "---NEXT VERSION---" && cat /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'
ls -la /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---SEARCH VIEW TRANSITIONS DOCS---" && ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "view|transition"

find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f -name "*.md" | grep -i -E "view|transition" ; echo "---ALL FILES IN 01-app---" ; find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -type f -name "*.md" | sort
grep -rn "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -40
grep -n "transitionTypes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md

ls /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/ ; echo "---SEARCH ALL---" ; grep -rln "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/ 2>/dev/null ; echo "---REACT VERSION---" ; cat /workspace/node_modules/react/package.json | grep '"version"'
sed -n '495,545p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md
grep -n "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
grep -n "typesVersions\|canary\|experimental\|\"types\"" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/package.json

grep -n "canary\|experimental\|ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20 ; echo "---LAST LINES---" ; tail -15 /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts

ls -la /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "---SEARCH REFS---"; grep -rn "react/canary\|react/experimental" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i "types\|reference\|canary" | head -10

grep -n "ViewTransition\|canary\|reference" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/experimental.d.ts | head ; echo "---NEXT types.d.ts---"; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/types.d.ts ; echo "---NEXT-ENV TEMPLATE?---"; grep -rn "next-env\|types.d.ts\|react/experimental\|preserve" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "env\|reference" | head
ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__/ ; echo "---"; for f in /workspace/__agent_eval__/*; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -80; done

grep -rln "ViewTransition\|viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/react-dom/cjs/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---SEARCH CLIENT---"; grep -rn "viewTransitionName\|ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/react-dom/client.js /workspace/node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rln "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/react-dom/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---react---"; grep -rln "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---react index---"; grep -rn "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/react/index.js 2>/dev/null

cat /workspace/node_modules/react/index.js; echo "---VERSIONS---"; node -e "console.log('react', require('/workspace/node_modules/react/package.json').version); console.log('react-dom', require('/workspace/node_modules/react-dom/package.json').version)"

grep -n "ViewTransition\|viewTransition\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | head; echo "---react-dom dev---"; grep -n "ViewTransition\|viewTransition\|startViewTransition\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -20

grep -n "exports\." /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | grep -i "transit\|view" ; echo "---ALL EXPORTS (first 60)---"; grep -nE "^\s*exports\.[A-Za-z]" /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | head -80
grep -rln "ViewTransition\|viewTransition\|startViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v "docs/" | head -20

grep -c "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js; echo "---react (compiled?)---"; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---check compiled react for VT---"; grep -rc "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/*.js 2>/dev/null | head

cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/package.json | grep '"version"'; echo "---index exports VT?---"; grep -n "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/index.js; echo "---react.react-server VT?---"; grep -n "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/react.react-server.js | head

cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null | grep -n "version ="; echo "---dev VT---"; grep -n "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---ls cjs---"; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/

grep -n "\"react\"\|\"react-dom\"\|peerDependencies" /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json | head; echo "---bundledReact config?---"; grep -rn "bundledReact\|compiled/react\|alias.*react" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "bundled\|compiled/react" | head; echo "---search config schema---"; grep -rn "bundledReact" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v docs | head

grep -rn "createVendoredReactAliases\|bundledReactChannel\s*=" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config/* /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v "esm/" | head; echo "---channel derivation---"; grep -rn "bundledReactChannel" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js | head
grep -n "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -30

ls /workspace/.eslintrc* /workspace/eslint.config* 2>/dev/null; grep -n "lint\|eslint" /workspace/package.json; echo "---react VT reference snippet---"; sed -n '3955,3995p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -50
cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "---git status---"; cd /workspace && git status --short
cd /workspace && git diff package.json tsconfig.json

cd /workspace && (npm run start >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6 ; echo "=== HOME (look for view-transition-name + nav-forward) ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "view-transition-name:[^;\"]*" | head ; echo "--- nav-forward class? ---" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "nav-forward" | head -3 ; echo "=== PRODUCT PAGE ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "view-transition-name:[^;\"]*" | head ; echo "--- product slug name present? ---" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "product-classic-sneakers" | head -3

cd /workspace && echo "=== context around product-classic-sneakers ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o ".\{60\}product-classic-sneakers.\{40\}" | head -4 ; echo ; echo "=== any view-transition in HTML at all? ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "view-transition[^\";{}<> ]*" | sort -u | head ; echo ; echo "=== style tags containing transition ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "<style[^>]*>[^<]*view-transition[^<]*</style>" | head -2 | cut -c1-300

cd /workspace && echo "=== home thumbnail vt-name + vt-share ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "vt-name=\"product-[^\"]*\" vt-[a-z]*=\"[^\"]*\"" | head ; echo "--- all vt-share on home ---" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "vt-share=\"[^\"]*\"" | sort -u ; echo "--- vt-enter / vt-exit present? (reveal + directional) ---" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "vt-enter=\"[^\"]*\"\|vt-exit=\"[^\"]*\"" | sort -u | head ; echo "--- server log errors? ---" ; grep -i "error\|unhandled\|cannot" /tmp/next-start.log | head

cd /workspace && echo "=== home flight data: directional VT (nav-back) ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "nav-back" | head -3 ; echo "--- directional VT enter/exit object serialized? ---" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '\$14[^}]*nav-forward[^}]*nav-back[^}]*' | head -1 | cut -c1-220 ; echo ; echo "=== product page: directional + back link nav-back ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "nav-back" | head -3 ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "vt-exit=\"[^\"]*\"" | sort -u
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; echo "server stopped"
cd /workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
